text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 480, "unit": "marbles", "kind": "count", "span": "480 marbles between them"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 6, "unit": "marbles", "kind": "count", "span": "heaps of 6 marbles"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 9, "unit": "marbles", "kind": "count", "span": "the other in heaps of 9 each"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 72, "unit": "heaps", "kind": "count", "span": "the total number of heaps is 72"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "if all 72 heaps were size 6: 6 * 72 = 432"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "shortfall vs actual 480 = 480 - 432 = 48"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q3", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "extra marbles per swapped heap = 9 - 6 = 3"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "number of heaps of 9 = 48 / 3 = 16"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q4", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "number of heaps of 6 = 72 - 16 = 56"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q3", "s4"], "out": "s6", "note": "marbles of the heaps-of-9 boy = 9 * 16 = 144"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "s5"], "out": "s7", "note": "marbles of the heaps-of-6 boy = 6 * 56 = 336"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many marbles each boy has (56 heaps of 6 = 336 marbles; 16 heaps of 9 = 144 marbles)"}, "dismissed": []}
